subject: Re: Kickoff: muNet multitask evolution — staffing + dependencies
body:
Hi Anders,

Staffing: Yara Jokic 50% leads the method port and owns the evolution runs; Hyun Traore 30% (he's also on a pruning project this window) advising on the parameter-sharing and mutation mechanics; Milan Zapata 40% through May on porting the notebook code into our training stack — note he's spoken for by other teams from June, so anything serving-side that slips past our window loses him.

Compute: evolution is search-shaped, so it's many medium jobs rather than one big one — I've sized it at 64 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort sustained through April.

On the Corpus side we have breathing room: the v2 migration freeze is 2026-08-07, so the task-suite datasets can stay on v1 pipelines through our whole window and the v2 port is a leisurely June/July item after we close.

One honest flag: the mutation search can grow the parameter footprint per added task; Yara will track parameters-per-task as a first-class metric so the cost comparison vs the fork farm stays fair.

Jelena
